steps.text: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot Castle to start the quest.
Go upstairs and talk to Merlin.
Go upstairs and talk to Merlin.
Go upstairs and talk to Merlin.
Head to Port Sarim and talk to a monk of Entrana for passage to Entrana. Bank all combat gear.
Talk to the High Priest on Entrana.
choices: Ask about the Holy Grail Quest

steps.text: Talk to Galahad in his house west of McGrubor's Woods.
choices: I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King.

steps.text: Travel to Draynor Manor.
Enter Draynor Manor.
Go up the stairs in Draynor Manor.
Go up the second set of stairs in Draynor Manor.
Open the door to the Magic Whistles.
Pickup 2 Magic Whistles.
Go retrieve Excalibur from your bank. If you do not own Excalibur, you can retrieve it from the Lady of the Lake in Taverley for 500 coins.
Go to the tower on Karamja near gold mine west of Brimhaven.
choices: I'd like to go to Brimhaven.

steps.text: Blow the whistle once you are underneath of the tower.
Kill the Black Knight Titan with Excalibur. Melee is recommended as it has high Ranged and Magic defence. (You only need to deal the killing blow with excalibur!)
Talk to the fisherman by the river. After talking to him walk West to the castle.
choices: Any idea how to get into the castle?

steps.text: Pickup the grail bell outside of the castle. If it's not there, return to the fisherman and finish the conversation.
choices: Any idea how to get into the castle?

steps.text: Ring the grail bell while standing directly north of the broken castle wall (Where you picked up the bell)
Ring the grail bell while standing directly north of the broken castle wall (Where you picked up the bell)
Go up the stairs inside of the castle.
Talk to The Fisher King.
Go back to Camelot.
Return to Camelot and talk to King Arthur.
Travel to the Goblin Village, north of Falador. Right click and open the sacks.
choices: Come with me, I shall make you a king.

steps.text: Go to the tower on Karamja near gold mine west of Brimhaven.
choices: I'd like to go to Brimhaven.

steps.text: Blow the whistle once you are underneath of the tower.
Open the door to the castle and enter.
Go up the stairs to the east.
Climb the ladder on the second floor.
Pickup the Holy grail.
Return to Camelot and talk to King Arthur
